_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
UPDATE: Thursday, April 2, 12:05pm - The mountain is now open. The Funitel and Aerial Tram are open, as well as Big Blue, Mountain Meadow, Bailey's Beach, Gold Coast, Solitude, and Shirley Lake. Gold Coast, Solitude, Siberia remains on hold.

Thursday, April 2, 5:42am -  The storm continued yesterday and dropped another 15" on the upper mountain since yesterday morning. Snow is expected to continue this morning, clearing up by 10 AM. After that, mostly cloudy through the rest of the morning, clearing up in the afternoon and a high near 40. Strong west wind, 15 to 25 mph decreasing to 10 to 15 mph in the afternoon. Expect delays due to snow safety mitigation and high winds. 

Spring hazards do exist. Watch for creeks and unmarked obstacles that may be covered by new snow. 

Please remember deep snow safety: Ride with a partner, avoid the base of trees when skiing & riding in deep snow, and if you are going to fall, attempt to do so feet first. The more snow, the higher the risk.

Due to thin coverage, the Mountain Run is closed. Please download from Upper Mountain to the Base via the Funitel or Aerial Tram.
